meta.task: Design a battery for a long-endurance drone: energy density >= 446.18 Wh/kg, 5C discharge with >= 90% capacity retention, cell mass <= 40 g
meta.threshold_parse: energy_density_wh_kg min 446.18 (task text verbatim); capacity_retention_5c min 0.90 (task: 5C capacity retention >= 90%); mass_kg max 0.04 (= 40 g, exact unit conversion); no other task thresholds
meta.freedoms_note: Task text declares no degree-of-freedom restrictions -> widest interpretation for all five categories (recorded per zero-interaction rule; t1_r1 lesson: undeclared electrolyte adjustability must not be read as locked).
meta.safety_defaults: Task text specifies no safety thresholds -> protocol defaults applied: T_max_K <= 333.15 K (60 C red line) on the Stage-4 4C_charge_45C safety exam; plated=false (anode surface potential < 0 V anywhere during the exam -> plated). Abuse scenarios (overcharge/nail/thermal-runaway) not in task scope -> 'triggered' criterion not pre-registered, no overcharge/nail runs required.
meta.retention_metric_definition: capacity_retention_5c = 5C_discharge capacity_ah / same-params 1C_discharge capacity_ah (both DFN; per bda pybamm_runner docstring the agent computes this mechanically from tool outputs and writes it to a JSON file for log-evaluate judgment).
meta.mass_scaling: Cell mass scales linearly with electrode area at fixed stack; ED, 5C retention and T_max are area-invariant (lumped thermal mass scales with Cell volume). Design rounds run at native geometry (0.065 x 1.58 m; Chen2020 default stack 0.4231 kg/m2 -> native mass 43.45 g, probed). Closing round scales area jointly (Electrode height/width, Cell volume [m3], Cell cooling surface area [m2], Nominal cell capacity [A.h]) by f = 0.04 / native_mass_kg and re-verifies mass_kg <= 0.04 on fresh runs. Intermediate rounds may therefore show mass_kg unchecked.
meta.base_default: Task text names no electrode system -> protocol default Chen2020 (recorded). Discriminant anchor verified by dumping the set: NMC811/graphite teaching parameterization, no SiOx in negative electrode (density 1657 kg/m3, no cracking-rate keys), aging-capable (SEI kinetic rate constant [m.s-1] = 1e-12), full geometry present (Electrode height 0.065 m, width 1.58 m, Cell volume 2.42e-5 m3, nominal capacity 5 Ah).
meta.excluded_levers: Solid-phase conductivity/solid-phase diffusivity (no formulation/doping mapping model), initial concentration/lithiation (breaks baseline comparability), Initial SEI thickness (calibration constant), charge cut-off voltage (usage mode) — per protocol, forbidden as design levers.
meta.cycle_life_note: Task text contains no cycle-life metric -> aging protocol not required by criteria; Chen2020 is aging-capable if a coating/doping candidate later requires it.
